sampling_model.design: Observational independent sampling from an unknown discrete-confounder law with fixed known overlap constant \(\epsilon\).
sampling_model.overlap: Null cells are permitted; positivity is imposed only when \(p_k>0\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Cell masses, propensities, and arm means are unknown. Estimators may use the known inputs \(n,d,\epsilon,M,\sigma\), must guard every denominator, and must return a value for every sample.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorems 2--4 establish binary-outcome unrestricted and exact-homogeneity rates, while Section 4.2 leaves intermediate maximal-radius dependence open.
The accepted same-class parent proves lower rate \(b_{n,d}+\sigma^2\min\{1,u_{n,d}\}\) and upper rate \(n^{-1}+\min\{1,u_{n,d},\sigma^2+d/n^2\}\).
A chi-square functional modulus is dual to a bias--variance optimization under convexity and compactness conditions.
Heavy--light polynomial estimation matches moment-based converses for separable large-alphabet functionals.

body.tldr: The kernel is the sharp finite-sample minimax MSE frontier for an identified ATE when high-dimensional discrete adjustment cells have effects within a calibrated maximal radius \(\sigma M\) of the ATE. The exact occupancy pilot and split-sample empirical-mass correction yield risk \(M^2\{n^{-1}+\sigma^2d^2/n^2\}\) for \(d\le n\), proving collision-scale estimation when \(\sigma^2d^2\le n\) and strictly tightening the accepted same-class bracket. At the unresolved benchmark \(d=n\), \(\sigma^2=\log^2(en)/n\), an explicit exactly normalized shared-design marked family fails because its global outcome shift makes the full mixtures asymptotically distinguishable. The open deliverable is the narrower benchmark repair via conditionally centered marked coupling, with no global frontier formula asserted until that construction passes.

project_justification.gap: The closest archival paper gives binary-outcome unrestricted and exact-homogeneity endpoints and explicitly leaves maximal-radius dependence unresolved; the accepted same-class parent narrows the issue to nonmatching rates.
project_justification.niche: Unknown random cell masses, unknown overlapping propensities, empty cells, self-centering around the ATE, and only conditional second moments make the residual converse neither fixed-design shrinkage nor a routine polynomial-functional problem.
project_justification.fill: The project establishes the empirical-mass collision subregion with a completely specified total estimator and proves a deterministic-design obstruction for the benchmark prior. The randomized shared-design marked-coupling repair remains an explicit open question.

body.related_work: Zeng, Balakrishnan, Han, and Kennedy (2024, revised 2026) provide the binary-outcome baseline in Theorems 2--4; Section 4.2 identifies the unresolved radius dependence and remarks that the rate statements extend under bounded conditional second moments, but their formal binary-outcome experiment is not identical to this real-outcome class. Their Section 7 analysis of 401(k) eligibility and net assets supplies the concrete consumer without validating overlap or reported intervals. The internal accepted parent supplies the same-class bracket and rules out a hypothesis-independent outcome-channel converse and an unstabilized centered factorial lift, but it is non-archival. Jiao, Venkat, Han, and Weissman (2015) inform the heavy--light approximation architecture. Wu and Yang (2019) inform moment-matched Poisson-mixture converses. Han, Jiao, and Weissman (2018) motivate local moment constraints. Orlitsky, Suresh, and Wu (2016) motivate randomized smoothing. Robins et al. (2017) inform projection-bias and degenerate-kernel-variance accounting. Polyanskiy and Wu (2026) inform the chi-square modulus and bias--variance dual, but do not resolve exact normalization, self-centering, or supportwise radius here.
body.technical_internal_limitation: A hypothesis-independent outcome-channel transfer gives only product-scale separation, and the natural centered linear Chebyshev factorial lift has excessive singleton-pair variance even with oracle centering at \(\sigma=0\). The explicit family \(\Pi_h^\star\) additionally shows that exact normalization, identical design marginals, supportwise radius, and separated ATEs are not enough: its hypothesis-wide outcome shift yields a sign test with total variation tending to one at \(d=n\) and \(\sigma^2=\log^2(en)/n\). Any replacement must remove that globally visible first-order coefficient and then control the full marked likelihood.
body.honest_scope: Consistency and exchangeability identify the displayed ATE, and the exact-homogeneity, unrestricted, and saturated reductions remain background sanity checks rather than root research statements. The empirical-mass risk lemma, refined infimum-risk bracket, collision-scale subregion, and benchmark failure lemma are concrete claims. The open content is only the benchmark marked-prior repair and, conditional on its success, extension across \(\mathcal W\). No global sharp rate, unspecified selector, unknown-radius adaptation, confidence interval, bounded-outcome assumption, overlap validation, or claim about the reported 401(k) intervals is included.
